name: b1_bakery_landing
request: Please make a landing page for my bakery, Sunrise Bakery, in Ibadan. It should have a big welcome headline with the bakery's name, show the three things we sell - fresh bread, birthday cakes and meat pies - with a short line about each, show our opening hours (Monday to Saturday, 7am to 7pm), and have a form where people can leave their email address to hear about new offers. After they send it, thank them. Keep the emails so I don't lose them. It must look good on a phone.
